S1329.reason: Under the VCLT and customary law, what matters is an intention to create legal obligations; neither a fixed form nor the label “treaty” is required.

S0686.reason: The power–duration relationship means the highest power that can be sustained falls as race distance (and duration) increases.

S1196.reason: In Nicaragua (“singly or collectively”), Oil Platforms (“even taken cumulatively”), and DRC v Uganda, the ICJ entertained cumulative force without rejecting the accumulation theory.
